versions.changelog:
Initial release of epic-cinematic-transform-video-gen-seedance2-0.

- Added eval.yaml for workflow evaluation.
- Added scripts/video_gen.js CLI for video generation with Seedance 2.0 model.
- Supports epic cinematic video creation from text brief or single image (public URL).
- Prompt expansion enforced for maximum cinematic effect.
- Only the SEEDANCE_2_0 model is permitted, with strict API/CLI contract and security boundaries.
- Refer to provided documentation and resources for usage and parameters.

epic-cinematic-transform-video-gen-seedance2-0 v0.1.0

- Initial release: creates epic, cinematic trailer-style short videos using WeryAI Seedance 2.0.
- Requires prompt expansion: user inputs are re-styled into blockbuster trailer cues unless a full prompt is supplied and opt-out is explicit.
- Supports both text-to-video and single-image-to-video (public HTTPS URLs only), in vertical (9:16), square (1:1), or widescreen (16:9) format up to 720p.
- Locked to the Seedance 2.0 model; no negative prompts, model defaults, or other models allowed.
- Mandatory confirmation step shows the full expanded prompt before video generation.
- Requires Node.js 18+ and setting the WERYAI_API_KEY environment variable.
